title_sq: OFROJ PER SHITJE APARTAMENT 2+1 NE AMBASADOR 3, PRANE STADIUMIT!
description_sq:
Ofroje per shitje apartament 2+1 i cili pozicionohet ne objektin prestigjoz Ambasador 3.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e nentembedhjete te objektit me orientim veri-perendim.
Apartamenti ka pamje te lire drejt Tiranes, eshte i investuar me cilesi bashkekohore.
Zona ofron sherbime te shumta per nje jetese sa me komforte.
Per te organizuar nje vizite ne prone, apo per informacione mos hezitoni te me kontaktoni.
title_en: OFFER FOR SALE 2+1 APARTMENT IN AMBASSADOR 3, NEAR THE STADIUM!
description_en: I offer for sale a 2+1 apartment located in the prestigious building Ambasador 3. The apartment is located on the nineteenth floor of the building, facing north-west. The apartment has a clear view towards Tirana, it is invested with contemporary quality. The area offers many services for a more comfortable life. To organize a visit to the property, or for information, do not hesitate to contact me.
